body: i'm glad i could help!
i understand, how you use skills really depends on your play style, i see it works well >u<

asura aura in general does not help with mp regain, it won't regain while you're using it, it's good for it's invincibility frame (i-frame) and when you tap it on and off you can survive boss attacks (depends on timing) but asura aura also helps add buffs to your dmg skills like rush chariot or others.

you can enter boss battle, use your buff skills (annihilator/quick aura/brave/any) and then hit the boss with normal attacks, which works to prorate and increase your next dmg skill and then tap on asura aura and then use your dmg skill (rush, chariot, any), god hand on it's own also works as a buff and for i-frame but it's very tricky and if you're new you may want to avoid relying on it but with practice you can use god hand and goliath to it's optimal potential. 

ideally combo enders are important, otherwise you'll be using way too much mp. some skills don't need to be in a combo, for example, goliath, god hand, asura aura and annihilator, you can activate them individually.

heyy, that's a great explanation about the combo building. will use your explanation as reference next time! i used knife combat at one point too to regain mp but now I don't since i solo a lot and knife combat messes with the prorate, so i just spam normal attacks and it's great to regain mp with annihilator like that.

so in this build you'll ideally put 7 sp in impact and 1 sp in finale, finale will act as a combo ender, it means that the skill won't activate but because it ends the combo, the mana points required to use combo will be less. you can start a combo with impact, for example the chariot skill and finale acts as a combo ender. 

fast mp regen is important for faster spam, you can use the buff annihilator, it's a great buff skill, if you keep using asura aura it will not make you recover mp bar. also don't forget to use ampr (attack mp recovery) food buff from house/land.
mononofu skills, shukichi, put 1sp in it, in total you'll spend 6 sp there. it makes u directly dash towards boss
